extraction.name: C-EVAL
extraction.description: A comprehensive Chinese evaluation suite designed to assess advanced knowledge and reasoning abilities of foundation models in a Chinese context. It comprises 13,948 multiple-choice questions across four difficulty levels spanning 52 diverse disciplines.
extraction.creator: Yuzhen Huang, Yuzhuo Bai, Zhihao Zhu, Junlei Zhang, Jinghan Zhang, Tangjun Su, Junteng Liu, Chuancheng Lv, Yikai Zhang, Jiayi Lei, Yao Fu, Maosong Sun, Junxian He
extraction.publisher: 37th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2023) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected from mock exams or small-scale local exams available online, past exam questions from top universities in China, and mock questions for the national graduate entrance exam.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: PDF or Microsoft Word documents and a minor fraction of web pages sourced from the internet, including freely available mock exams and authorized content from the Weipu website.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Questions were processed to include exactly four choices. Questions with fewer than four options were eliminated, and incorrect choices were randomly dropped for questions with more than four options. Complex mathematical notations were manually converted into standard LATEX formats.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: PDF documents were initially processed into text. All questions were subsequently parsed automatically or manually into a structured format, followed by a standard data preprocessing pipeline including deduplication and cleaning.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For the development split, GPT-4 was prompted to generate step-by-step explanations for the ground-truth answers. These generated explanations were then manually revised by the authors to obtain the final explanations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The questions underwent several rounds of human validation by the authors, and all LATEX notations were ensured to compile without syntax errors.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is anticipated to help analyze important strengths and shortcomings of foundation models, foster their development and growth for Chinese users, and guide developers in preparing LLMs to function in more complex scenarios.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset exhibits minor option bias, with small fluctuations in the proportion of different correct options (A, B, C, D) around a random 25% level.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark is limited to multiple-choice questions and does not evaluate other abilities such as reasoning over and calling APIs, nor does it assess aspects beyond accuracy like safety, bias, and robustness.
